author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Tall boot with sloped collar, straight shaft front, rounded instep and toe, two posts and a full-width flat blade; matches the reference silhouette (old drawing had an overhanging toe and hooked blade).
omissions: The reference's thin outlined pill blade is one round-capped stroke (an outlined pill needs 8 of height), and each double post is a single post.
